question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg" AS wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df vw
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vw.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE substr(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020','2021','2022','2023')
),
transactions_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year,
        vc.category_name,
        SUM(vt."qty_sold(kg)" * vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vt
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vt.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020','2021','2022','2023')
      AND vt."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY substr(vt.txn_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
loss_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        AVG(vl."loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vl
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vl.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.year,
    w.category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w.wholesale_price) - MIN(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(SUM(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_selling_price, 0), 2) AS total_selling_price,
    ROUND(COALESCE(l.avg_loss_rate, 0), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(COALESCE(l.avg_loss_rate, 0) * SUM(w.wholesale_price) / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_selling_price, 0) - SUM(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale w
LEFT JOIN transactions_agg t ON w.year = t.year AND w.category_name = t.category_name
LEFT JOIN loss_agg l ON w.category_name = l.category_name
GROUP BY w.year, w.category_name, t.total_selling_price, l.avg_loss_rate
ORDER BY w.year, w.category_name
